material.description: OpenStax Introduction to Political Science, §1.5 “Empirical Political Science” (https://openstax.org/books/introduction-political-science/pages/1-5-empirical-political-science): the section describes empirical political science as inquiry into what is, using verifiable facts, evidence and data to test hypotheses, and distinguishes empirical questions from normative questions. This supports the Claim’s observable-data and verifiable-evidence framing; the source also notes that facts may be disputed or difficult to establish.
